prompt: In which year since 1880 did the global temperature anomaly exceed 1 degree Celsius and 2 degrees Fahrenheit simultaneously for the first time in recorded history?
answer: **2015**. It was the first year since modern recordkeeping began in 1880 when the global temperature anomaly exceeded both **1°C** and **2°F** above the late-19th-century baseline.
